requirements.title: Ephemeral & Cloud-Runner Nodes
requirements.description: A node can be a VM or a cloud macOS/Windows runner provisioned on demand, not only a physical machine. Bridge treats a node as 'any reachable Vrooli install,' so ephemeral capacity composes without special-casing. P2: designed and recorded as a future seam (extends registry node-kind metadata + a provider integration), not built here.

validation.notes: Recorded as a future seam (OT-P2-003) in the Phase 6 P2 table: node kind is registry metadata, not a code branch, so ephemeral/cloud nodes reuse the existing registration + dispatch path; the on-demand provider integration is a separate initiative. Reuses the registry + provision seams (SEAMS.md 'exposed (not built) consumer seams').
